Class DeckList

java.lang.Object
util.List<Deck>
parking.DeckList
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Deck>
public class DeckList extends List<Deck>
DeckList class that holds the parking decks. It extends the generic List class with the operations specific to a list of decks; closed decks remain in the list.
